# COAF fixtures — synthetic

`coaf-sintetico.xlsx` is generated by the test builder (`xlsx_builder_test.go`, archive/zip only, stored entries,
fixed timestamps) from `fixtureRows` in `provider_test.go`. Every name and reference is invented; countries use the
ISO 3166 user-assigned codes `XA`/`XB`. Never replace it with the real list (owner decision 2026-11-10).

- `go test ./pkg/sanctions/coaf -run TestFixtureMatchesBuilder -update-fixture` regenerates the workbook;
- `golden.json` is the expected `[]sanctions.Entry`, written by hand; `-update` rewrites it from the parser.
